MANIFEST-INPUT-001.rationale: Project setup requires an explicit deployment input and writes the exact Kubernetes sources into the project pipeline declaration.

MANIFEST-INPUT-002.rationale: Both paths reject repository escape, and the replacement also rejects project-root escape, chart symlinks, and non-regular files before tool execution.

MANIFEST-INPUT-003.rationale: Explicit raw-manifest and Helm-chart arrays replace hidden discovery. The real Nova stage reads these arrays from the project pipeline declaration.

MANIFEST-INPUT-004.rationale: The replacement applies operator-bounded file, byte, rendered-output, and document limits before expensive parsing or schema work.

MANIFEST-YAML-001.rationale: Invalid YAML fails in both paths, with the replacement retaining a stable typed error and source path instead of relying on a console summary.

MANIFEST-YAML-002.rationale: Every declared document is parsed strictly with bounded aliases and aggregate document limits rather than silently aggregating only supported workloads.

MANIFEST-SCHEMA-001.rationale: Raw Kubernetes YAML now receives strict validation against a declared, local, versioned schema set before it can be accepted.

MANIFEST-SCHEMA-002.rationale: Rendered Helm resources use the same strict schema authority as raw manifests and retain their chart and template source identity.

MANIFEST-SCHEMA-003.rationale: Schema locations must be absolute operator-controlled local paths, so pipeline runs cannot fetch mutable or unapproved schema content.

MANIFEST-POLICY-001.rationale: Required environment variables are evaluated for each container and resolved through declared Secret and ConfigMap envFrom sources when available.

MANIFEST-POLICY-002.rationale: Secret references are checked across all declared Secrets, namespaces, direct keys, envFrom sources, optional references, and init containers.

MANIFEST-POLICY-003.rationale: Private images accept direct pod credentials or ServiceAccount credentials and are checked separately for every regular and init container.

MANIFEST-POLICY-004.rationale: Readiness and liveness probes are evaluated independently for every regular container, so one valid container cannot hide another missing probe.

MANIFEST-POLICY-005.rationale: CPU and memory limits are checked independently for regular and init containers, with distinct findings for each missing resource limit.

MANIFEST-POLICY-006.rationale: Operator-installed policy packs are versioned, size bounded, rule bounded, and verified against their declared SHA-256 content digest.

MANIFEST-POLICY-007.rationale: Projects can select only policy-pack identifiers that the operator installed and approved; project content cannot install executable policy code.

MANIFEST-LOCATION-001.rationale: Normalized findings identify the raw file or Helm source template and include a parser-derived line whenever a source node exists.

MANIFEST-EVIDENCE-001.rationale: Input, render, schema-output, and policy-pack digests remain bounded structured evidence without leaking temporary host paths.

MANIFEST-AUTHORITY-001.rationale: The production pipeline runs Nova lint after merged review and before operator approval. No Buster manifest result can authorize deployment.

MANIFEST-AUTHORITY-002.rationale: The atomic cutover marks manifest migrated, rejects it in the legacy protocol, deletes its runner, and leaves Nova lint as the only authority.

MANIFEST-DEFECT-001.rationale: Per-container probe and resource findings prevent one valid container from hiding missing requirements on another container.

MANIFEST-DEFECT-002.rationale: All declared Secret resources are indexed by namespace and name instead of treating one configured Secret file as the complete authority.

MANIFEST-DEFECT-003.rationale: Declared Secret and ConfigMap envFrom sources contribute their exact keys, while unresolved sources produce precise container findings.

MANIFEST-DEFECT-004.rationale: ServiceAccount imagePullSecrets are resolved in the workload namespace and count as valid private-registry credentials.

MANIFEST-DEFECT-005.rationale: Every workload document retains a separate kind, name, source, document index, and location through policy evaluation and reporting.

MANIFEST-DEFECT-006.rationale: Structured findings and immutable evidence are authoritative; console summaries cannot replace or modify the recorded source facts.

MANIFEST-SECURITY-001.rationale: Manifest, chart, pack, project-root, and schema authorities reject traversal, symlink escape, unapproved paths, and network locations.

MANIFEST-SCOPE-001.rationale: The replacement performs static file and render checks only; Kubernetes apply, readiness, health, and runtime behavior remain separate tests.
